name: Yara Nasser
about_me: I'm Yara, a pediatrics resident at Michigan Medicine interested in telehealth for rural families. I want a research mentor and a startup to partner with on a pilot.

debriefs.text: Carmen Diaz, a pediatric nurse practitioner, is starting a telehealth service for rural families. We might collaborate on a pilot.
Priyanka Desai, an angel who sold a telehealth company, offered to talk about what makes telehealth stick.
Prof. Farah Siddiqui in Public Health does rural access research and might co-mentor.
Bethany Kowalski runs the clinical innovation pilot program and said residents can propose pilots.
Met Arjun Shah, CTO of Clearpath Meds, who said their app could support pediatric dosing reminders.
